name: Moravská Třebová (Czechia)
description: Blue field with a red and white chequered eagle with yellow crown and claws bearing a blue shield with a yellow letter T.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 July 1993 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
